title: Friday Night Magic 2009: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.
Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.
After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.
Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.
"Even the threat of power has power." —Jeska, warrior adept
Slain orochi warriors were buried with a tree sapling so they would become a part of the forest after death.
